body:
#2620 (BUG-1993, agy) r1: REQUEST CHANGES at 08fc62363e (STANDARD; unrecorded). The full text is on the PR.
- B1: the PR claims a 5000ms ceiling guarantee, but its budgets are only checked before each step, not during it; the worst case is still about 9-10s.
- B2: the fixture has no commits, so the changed budgets are never exercised (a 5s-sleep mutant passes).
Please route it to the agy factory.
subject: #2620 REQUEST CHANGES: route to factory
